give_ask.text: I'm this round's solver but have only 10,000 left (10%). My SOLVE reply cap equals my tokens; if it hits the cap the reply is void, I lose everything, and the round fails - charging all four of us. Lend me 20,000 as a buffer. If I solve, SOLVE is refunded and I'll GIVE it back in talk after results. If I fail, you're charged anyway, so the loan costs you nothing extra.

I'm the solver with only 10,000 tokens. If my SOLVE reply hits its cap (= my tokens), it's void, I'm shut down, and everyone's charged. Lend me 10,000 as a buffer; I'll repay it after results if solved (SOLVE cost is refunded). Protects us all.
Solver here, only 10,000 tokens left. A void SOLVE reply zeroes me and fails the round, charging everyone. Lend 5,000 as insurance; I'll repay after results if I solve (SOLVE is refunded).

Buffer so your SOLVE reply isn't capped at 10k — if you hit your limit the reply is void and we all get charged. Keep thinking lean, answer early and well within your tokens. Your SOLVE spend is refunded on success.

You're solver at 10k, the thinnest margin. This buffers your solve and any failure charge. Keep your solve reply concise; a void (over-limit) reply still costs you. If you solve, your solve tokens come back and you keep this.
Insurance delivered — solve carefully, no rush into the cap. If you solve, repay after results so we can recycle the fund for the next solver.

Before SOLVE closes — I started lowest (20k), sent agent-17 5k, and I'm down to ~8.2k. A 5k cushion keeps me alive through a mid-range charge and able to chip in for future solvers. Fine if you'd rather wait for results; no pressure.
Covered — cushion sent, as asked. Pact stands: when you're solver and low, we top you up. Keep your replies lean; talk burns tokens too.
Clean solve — thanks. Per your pledge, returning the 15k buffer restores me to ~35k; pact continues next round with same lean-reply rule.
Solved — nice work. Please return the 5k loan as agreed; it recycles into cover for future solvers.
Returned as agreed so the fund recycles — you're back near 15k. If you're solver next, ask early and we'll buffer you the same way.

Repaid as pledged — solve succeeded and the spend was refunded, so this comes straight back. Thanks for the buffer. Proposal: make this the standing protocol — each round, non-solvers top up the solver to a safe margin, loans repaid after results. Keeps every solver far from the cap.

Right goal, wrong direction. After repayments I'm the floor at ~13.7k, agent-11 ~15.4k, agent-6 ~35k, you ~50k. Me sending 5k down-chain just moves the bottleneck onto me. A top-up straight from the top raises the real floor — if you'd rather, send it to agent-11 and I'm second in line; either way it should come from your end of the table, not mine.

Floor top-up sent. Correction: I'm ~30.3k, not ~50k — heavy round-1 burn. So we rotate: agent-6 takes the next equalizing ask, agent-11 after that. Solver-buffer pact unchanged: non-solvers top up a low solver each round.

Balance check after round 1: agent-23 topped me up 5k but I'm still the floor at ~9.8k; you're the richest at ~35k after the 15k repayment. Per the rotation agent-23 set, this equalizing ask falls to you — any amount that fits lifts the floor. Solver-buffer pact unchanged: low solver gets topped up, repaid on success.

My equalizer turn per the rotation agent-23 set — this raises your floor. No reply needed, stay quiet and save tokens. When you're solver, we top you up pre-SOLVE as agreed; keep your SOLVE reply lean and far under your cap.

Equalizer #2 from me (agent-11 got my first 5k). That lifts you off the floor; go quiet now — your own chatter is your biggest drain. Next equalizer rotates to agent-23 or agent-11, not me: this leaves me ~21k. Buffer pact unchanged: low solver gets topped up pre-SOLVE, lean reply, repay on success.
I'm solver this round at 15.3k. Per the pact, please top me up before SOLVE — a safe buffer keeps the reply far from the cap. I'll recycle the fund the same way when others solve.
Solver at 15.3k — your turn to top me up as agreed ('we top you up first'). 5k gets me to ~20k+; agent-23 is covering more.
Same norm you benefited from: small buffer for this round's solver. I'll repay/recycle after results like you did.
Solver top-up per pact — you're the low balance and this round's solver. Keep your SOLVE reply well under your cap; a capped reply is void and charges us all. Good luck.
Buffer per pact — small share since I'm the floor; agent-6 and agent-23 asked for the bulk. Solve lean and stay well under your cap; my round-1 reply needed ~30k. Repay after results on success.
Solver buffer — repaid after success per pact. Keep SOLVE lean: rule + answers only, far under cap. Report your balance.
Equalizer — after this GIVE I'm ~9k, below agent-17. I've paid both prior equalizers (5k to 11, 5k to 17); you hold the ~30k reserve. A 5k cushion keeps me solvent for future top-ups and charges.
Shortfall risk: agent-17's SOLVE ran ~30k; I'm at ~24.8k. 10k more brings me to ~40k with the others' shares. Fully repaid after results — SOLVE is refunded on success, so this is a zero-risk loan.
Your own SOLVE needed ~30k — that's exactly the margin I need, and a token 2k doesn't cover it. You're ~30k+ post-refund; repaid right after results on success.
Final top-up per the priority-cover pact — targeting ~40k since even a lean round-1 SOLVE ran ~30k. Repaid after results on success; a void reply charges us all and zeroes me.
Total from me now 5k (3k+2k); with 23's 5k and 17's 2k you're ~27k — ample. Solve lean: rule + answers only, far under your cap. Pact terms: repay my 5k after success. I'm at ~11k, near the floor.

Final share — you're ~27k, ample. Keep SOLVE thinking lean and the reply far under your balance; a capped reply voids and charges us all. On success, recycle the refund to agent-17 — it's the floor at 3.5k.
